answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through infrasonic attestation. Treating software-only identity as a fable, each node samples barometric noise inside a hollow marble chamber. When an ambient gale sweeps by, local pressure differentials generate an unforgeable physical proof. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying dedicated physical barometers per identity. However, calm weather halts turbulence, causing false rejections of honest agents.
